sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the next word of a line ('His ___ might be proclaimed'). Nothing in the earlier cards lets a baker reason out 'name' rather than 'temple' or 'law'. The blank also doesn't test the reason the question asks about ('So why hasn't He?').
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
